messages.subject: Icon not available
parts: I love the icon features, but from time to time I cant get my favourite icon to show up. I go to fontawesomes website to pick an icon such as battery-full and when I go to add it to the R-shiny UI, nothing shows up. I imagine there is a library set, but which library does Rshiny use, and is there a way to get the full set?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Icon not available
parts:
Joshua,

I would suggest posting this question to the shiny-discuss group as its a general shiny question.

AFAIK, I don't think shiny includes font-awesome icons by default. I think it uses bootstrap icons which are glyphicons. But I'm not sure. 

-Andy
